prompts.base:
Create a professional MODELING REFERENCE SHEET for Uryu Ishida from Bleach, for our Minecraft Forge / Blockbench project. Landscape high-resolution image, light warm-gray background, neutral flat studio lighting, extremely crisp technical illustration. Supporting reference image: the attached earlier project storyboard; use ONLY its dark blue hair, rectangular glasses, white/blue Quincy identity, discard its excessive ornamental armor and dramatic VFX. This is an ASSET TURNAROUND, no story panels, no scenery.
Title "ISHIDA — BASE / MODEL REFERENCE". Exactly TWO ROWS, FIVE matching VIEWS per row: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE, BACK, RIGHT PROFILE, FRONT 3/4. Top row CLEAN SMOOTH simplified 3D volumes (smooth surfaces, simple planar hair, no tiny detail); bottom row BLOCKBENCH rectangular cuboid interpretation of exactly the same design, same clothing, proportions, scale, orientation, A-pose. Large readable full-body figures with shoes included. Same baseline and height for all figures. Use Minecraft player proportions as the structural target: large head, compact torso, straight forearms and legs, hands simple mitten blocks; NOT tall realistic anatomy in one row and short Minecraft anatomy in other. Black-blue straight parted hair, pale skin, thin rectangular glasses, white high-collar long Quincy coat with simple blue piping, dark blue waist belt, straight white trousers, white shoes, only two simple coat tails, no cape, no pauldrons, no armor plates, no jewelry. Arms slightly away from body in relaxed A-pose for limb separation. NO BOW, NO WINGS, NO STARS in this base character sheet. Small separate inset with head front/side and coat seam layout, no duplicate full figure. Thin pale grid, small pivot dots at shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, labels for head/torso/coat tails; no invented precise measurements. Indicate FRONT=-Z, BACK=+Z. All views anatomically consistent; glasses only on front of face, belt continues round back, same hair. No glow, bloom, smoke, sparks, decorative floating fragments, text paragraphs. This is a proposed Ishida NPC/reference body, not a replacement for the player's skin. Prioritize usable silhouette and construction over illustration drama.

prompts.bow_attempt_1:
Create a landscape high-resolution TECHNICAL BOW EVOLUTION MODEL SHEET for Uryu Ishida in our Bleach Minecraft Blockbench project. Input 1 defines character palette only; input 2 older project concept inspires final white/cyan reishi bow but DO NOT copy its ornate random shards. No character full body. Plain warm-gray grid, crisp flat illumination, no bloom, no sparks, no scenery. Title "QUINCY — BOW EVOLUTION / DESIGN PROPOSAL".
THREE equal columns with headings "01 KOJAKU", "02 GINREI KOJAKU", "03 VOLLSTANDIG". Each column contains TWO matched horizontal bands: upper CLEAN SMOOTH simplified physical volume and lower BLOCKBENCH cuboids version of exactly the SAME bow. In each band show large front elevation, narrower side elevation and small 3/4 view of the same bow. Keep center grips at same baseline and use a common scale so the three silhouettes compare. Every bow has ONE continuous fine cyan string connecting top and bottom tips behind central grip, correct archery geometry and usable free grip, no crossbow mechanisms, no sword handle, no floating broken bow limbs.

Stage 3 retains central grip, refined white/cyan open-frame angular limbs with two slim outer energy rails and a simple diamond central node, powerful but buildable from limited rigid parts; no excessive extra spikes. All three remain upright archery bows, not staffs. Thin construction leaders identify grip, string_anchor_top, string_anchor_bottom, arrow_rest, limb_upper, limb_lower. At footer small drawing sequence using SAME side view of stage 3: rest, partial draw, full draw with string displaced by drawing hand and single arrow nocked; LEFT hand on bow grip, RIGHT hand pulls to cheek; preserve grip position, no extra arm. No numerical damage stats or canon claims. Mark clean/block variants and all stages as modeling proposals, no stylistic drift between views. Make the block versions truly rectangular/taper approximated with stepped rotated cuboids, not smooth shapes with pixel texture.
